title: Substring of Sorted String
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq N \leq 10^5; S is a string of length N consisting of lowercase English letters.; 1 \leq Q \leq 10^5; For each query of the first kind, 1 \leq x \leq N.; For each query of the first kind, c is a lowercase English letter.; For each query of the second kind, 1 \leq l \leq r \leq N.
